name: @aireos/smoke
description: Browser smoke suite (T-034) — the headless §12 governed-egress walkthrough. Deliberately OUTSIDE the pnpm workspace: a standalone npm island so Playwright (a heavyweight devDep) can never enter apps/web's build graph, the shipped service closure, or the offline bundle. Dev/CI-only; runs in the pinned Playwright Docker image (infra/docker-compose/docker-compose.smoke.yml).
